consumer: mission::is_complete for MGOAL_FIND_ITEM, asking the yes/no 'is the delivery quest's item requirement satisfied?' that gates quest completion
scope: items reachable for the find-item objective via crafting_inventory() (own carried items PLUS nearby/reachable items), not just the character's own carried items
decisive_source: src/mission.cpp::mission::is_complete (MGOAL_FIND_ITEM) — evaluates the requirement by calling u.crafting_inventory() and testing has_amount/has_charges(type->item_id, item_count), returning the engine-computed yes/no
divergence: The required item sits on the ground or in a nearby vehicle within crafting reach but is NOT carried: crafting_inventory() counts it so the quest IS satisfied, whereas a carried-items-only answer (avatar.carried_items[] from write_carried_items) reports unsatisfied — wrong reach exposed
